review_notes: The verse holds both homographs of אֵת: s007 is the preposition H854, which MACULA tags R, and s015 is the object marker H853, tagged To. Both are unrepresented, but for different reasons — rule 40 for the preposition the ASV's recasting silences, rule 16 for the marker whose object the ASV writes bare.
made ... to grow is headed on grow under rule 44's second-verb complement clause.
Two the's are written for עֲצֵי הַשָּׂדֶה, so the construct takes a supplied one and the article the one standing before its own word (rule 29).
